items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: He was brought up by I think Eddie Marrero or Simon or John.

ctx.x: He hung up with that one son of a day. He's a little son of a day.
He used to drink. He was brought up by I think Eddie Marrero or Simon or John. One of those brothers you know. Marrero, Moran they call him.
I don't know if he drinks. He used to drink. He drinks. He still drinks. I haven't seen him in quite a while.
